macro.label: VIX: 19.45
macro.text: The S&P 500 closed at 7,623.68. VIX recovered from Wednesday's 16.68 after Thursday's chip selloff. Waiting for the Fed may reduce premium as event uncertainty clears.

macro.label: Brent crude: $116.72
macro.text: Oil rose about 6% last week after attacks on Saudi targets. Energy contributed to September inflation; Thursday's PCE release covers that month.

macro.label: Fed, inflation and technology earnings
macro.text: The Fed decision is Wednesday at 11:00 AM Pacific. GDP, PCE and claims follow Thursday at 5:30 AM Pacific. Microsoft and Alphabet report Wednesday evening; Amazon and Intel report Thursday evening. Chip and cloud setups wait until Friday.

macro.label: Expiry risks and position management
macro.text: No listed contract expires Oct 30. Nov 6 contracts span Apple's Nov 2 earnings, AMD and Arista earnings and elections Nov 3, then expiry-day jobs. Nov 13 contracts span Nov 10 CPI and Nov 13 PPI. GE also spans Nov 25 PCE, the Nov 26 market closure, Dec 4 jobs, Dec 9 Fed, Dec 10 CPI and Dec 15 PPI. The source suggests a GTC buyback at 50% of entry credit and sizing puts for assignment and calls for delivery.

days.rule: No new entries from this slate. Covered calls begin Wednesday; puts wait until Thursday and chip and cloud names until Friday. Oil and geopolitical developments can still move prices.

days.name: Tuesday
days.rule: No new entries scheduled. Keep DAL, UNH and GE for Wednesday after the relevant airline, health insurer and aerospace reports.

days.name: Wednesday
days.rule: Four covered calls have a 7:45-10:00 AM Pacific window, after oil inventories and the relevant peer reports. Defer unfilled orders after 10:00 AM Pacific until Thursday.
